title: Work scheme composition
question: The roll dealt three ways to break the text wall with real process photography from fisheye-interior.com/workscheme. Lock one — Parchment Atelier identity stays.

options.label: Horizontal proof chapters
options.thesis: Stages become a scrubbed horizontal plate row — site photos, layouts, and viz tiles lead; copy rides beside or under each plate.
options.viewport: Title + one line; then a full-width proof strip opens on Measurements with a real plate before any long body copy.
options.risk: Long process copy can feel cramped under a photo-first rhythm if measures stay too tight.

raised.raise: Each plate carries a Fig. numeral that links stage to proof, so the sequence reads as one invention’s figures.
Every stage keeps a deep-linkable id so share and scroll-to stay precise.

options.case: Most photographic: the live workscheme assets become the page’s memory, not decoration after text.

options.label: Split dossier
options.thesis: Left: numbered stage index. Right: one focused stage with matching process plate — prev/next walks the dossier.
options.viewport: Split first screen: stage list beside a large plate + title for Contacting the studio.
options.risk: Can feel Operate-heavy for a Persuade marketing route; mobile must stack without losing the plate.
options.case: Most interactive walkthrough; photography stays locked to the active stage.

options.label: Sticky index + media
options.thesis: Sticky stage rail tracks scroll; each stage is a ruled row with an interleaved process plate from the live site.
options.viewport: Headline + support; stage 01 opens with copy and a site or layout plate beside the giant numeral.
options.risk: Sticky + Lenis needs careful mobile behavior so the rail does not fight scroll.
options.case: Best for long factual process: motion shows place in the journey while photos break the wall.

options.label: Patent figure sheet
options.thesis: Process as one invention sheet: Fig. numerals, leader lines, plates as exploded views of the project.
options.viewport: Ruled sheet head with title; Fig. 01–03 plates explode across the first viewport.
options.case: Strong clarity, weaker luxury-audience identification than photo-led forms.
options.kept: Fig. numerals linking stage to proof — raised into Horizontal proof chapters.
options.risk: Reads engineering-doc more than Marbella atelier if leaders dominate.
